rationale: The -5.2% gap on 9.4x relative volume has resolved into balance: price is pinned mid-range (47% of day range), sitting essentially on VWAP, with the last five one-minute candles confined to a ~5-cent band on per-minute volume that has collapsed to a few hundred shares — compression with no directional resolution.
